name: Corvane
tagline: The living intelligence layer for the world's moving fleets
positioning: Corvane fuses every vehicle signal into one predictive telemetry grid, so enterprise fleets stop reacting to breakdowns and start commanding them.

hero.h1: Every vehicle, every second, one intelligence grid
hero.sub: Corvane ingests raw telematics from 40,000-vehicle fleets and turns it into decisions — predicting failures, rerouting assets, and settling disputes before your dispatchers finish their coffee.

features.title: Predictive failure horizon
features.description: Corvane models each drivetrain against 2 billion telemetry hours and flags the exact component failing 9 days out — with the work order pre-filled for your shop.

features.title: Unified signal fabric
features.description: OBD-II, CAN bus, dashcam, ELD, and fuel-card data collapse into one canonical vehicle record. No more reconciling four dashboards at 2 a.m.

features.title: Live dispute ledger
features.description: Every hard-brake, geofence breach, and idle event is timestamped and cryptographically sealed, so damage claims resolve from evidence, not memory.

features.title: Autonomous rerouting
features.description: When a lane closes or a trailer overheats, Corvane recomputes the network and pushes new routes to drivers before dispatch even sees the alert.

features.title: Fleet-wide energy map
features.description: Track fuel and kWh per mile across mixed diesel and EV fleets, and forecast charging load against your depot's grid capacity.

features.title: Command-grade uptime
features.description: A 99.99% SLA, region-isolated ingestion, and SOC 2 Type II controls built for fleets that cannot afford a dark dashboard.

testimonials.quote: Corvane cut our unplanned roadside events by 41% in two quarters. The failure-horizon alerts land in our maintenance queue with the part number already attached — that changed how the whole shop operates.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: We ripped out three telematics vendors and consolidated onto Corvane's signal fabric. For the first time our safety, ops, and finance teams argue from the same numbers.
testimonials.name: Marcus Oyelaran

testimonials.quote: The sealed dispute ledger paid for the platform in one contested collision claim. Legal had timestamped evidence in minutes instead of subpoenaing dashcams for weeks.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman
